items.requirement: A Building Permit is required to create an ADU; there are no exemptions.

source.quote: A Building Permit is required to create an ADU or JADU. There are no exemptions.

items.item: Permit type depends on number of units
items.requirement: Either a Combination Building Permit or a Building Permit is issued depending on how many dwelling units the ADU(s) create.

source.quote: either a Combination Building Permit or a Building Permit will be issued

items.notes: IB 400 sends the reader to IB 125 to confirm permit type; IB 125 was not provided. The 2023 guide (p.8) says to select Combination Building Permit for a single family dwelling or duplex.

items.requirement: A Coastal Development Permit is required for ADUs in the Coastal Overlay Zone that include conversion of non-habitable space (or are not fully inside the existing primary structure, or add habitable area).

source.quote: A Coastal Development Permit (CDP) is required for the creation of all ADUs and JADUs within the Coastal Overlay Zone

items.notes: Exact exceptions are in the text after this quote. IB 400 p.4 calls garages 'non-livable space', but no document says outright that a garage counts as non-habitable for the CDP rule. DSD should confirm.

not_found.expected_item: List of documents the online portal will require for this scenario
not_found.why_expected: Guide p.18 says 'Required documents will be listed' after the form questions, but no document lists them.

not_found.expected_item: Fee amounts for a garage-to-ADU permit
not_found.why_expected: IB 400 and IB 140 name fees but point to IB 501, which was not provided.

not_found.expected_item: Garage-conversion-specific plan requirements (e.g. existing garage slab, wall infill where the garage door was, ceiling height)
not_found.why_expected: The documents mention garage conversion only for parking and setbacks; no plan content specific to converting a garage is stated.

not_found.expected_item: Specific Title 24 forms required for an ADU
not_found.why_expected: IB 400 says only 'Title 24 Energy calculations'; IB 140 names MF-1R and CF-1R for additions/alterations but not for ADUs.

not_found.expected_item: Which permit type (Building vs Combination) applies to one ADU on a single-family lot
not_found.why_expected: IB 400 defers to IB 125, which was not provided.

not_found.expected_item: Proof of ownership or owner authorization documents
not_found.why_expected: Not mentioned; only the owner's name, address and phone on the site plan and an Applicant type question are.

not_found.expected_item: Utility, sewer or water service requirements for the ADU
not_found.why_expected: Not mentioned in the four documents; only the DS-16 water meter card.

not_found.expected_item: Number of plan sets or required signatures/stamps on plans (other than truss calcs and surveyor)

not_found.why_expected: IB 140 p.4 refers to Figure 12 for emergency escape windows in bedrooms (figure is an image), and IB 400 p.5 refers to California Building Standards Code room dimensions; ceiling height is not mentioned.

not_found.expected_item: Garage-to-ADU fire separation or rated wall details
not_found.why_expected: IB 400 mentions fire separation distance and opening protection only generally, with no plan detail requirement.
